title: WALTEUR brownfield non-regression proof
description: Machine-checkable portion of walteur-kit/non-regression.json (the PROVE-phase contract, §2.6 BROWNFIELD UPGRADE). The terminal brownfield ship blocker: it proves the upgraded app is >= the captured baseline on EVERY dimension (no silent regression), that the characterization/golden-master net is still green (behavior preserved), and that any intended behavior change carries a signed ADR. Enforced by non-regression-gate.sh (HARD for brownfield); the gate RE-DERIVES 'regressed' from before/after rather than trusting the recorded flag (evidence over assertion).

proven_ts.description: ISO-8601 time the after-snapshot was taken — must be after the baseline

baseline_ref.description: path to the walteur-kit/baseline.json this proof compares against

after.description: the after-upgrade snapshot, same shape as baseline (build/tests) — the post-upgrade state

dimensions.description: every baseline dimension compared before->after. The gate fails if any after<before unless that dimension carries a signed waiver_ref. 'regressed' is advisory — the gate recomputes it from before/after.

before.description: the baseline score for this dimension

after.description: the post-upgrade score for this dimension

regressed.description: advisory — the gate re-derives this as (after<before)

waiver_ref.description: path to a signed risk-acceptance/ADR record permitting an intentional drop on this dimension (rare; e.g. removed a deprecated feature)

characterization.description: the golden-master net re-run after the upgrade — green means observable behavior was preserved

behavior_changes.description: intentional changes to observable behavior. Each MUST cite a signed ADR (adr_ref) — an unsigned behavior change is a silent breaking change and FAILS the gate. Empty = behavior fully preserved (the default for a refine-in-place upgrade).

change.description: what observable behavior changed and why

adr_ref.description: path to the signed ADR (walteur-kit/adr/*) recording the decision, rationale, and Tony sign-off

waivers.description: signed exceptions permitting a specific dimension to drop (mirrors dimensions[].waiver_ref). Each names the dimension, the reason, and the signer.

verdict.description: self-reported verdict — the gate verifies it independently and does not trust it
